summary: Plan professional connections, referral pathways, and follow-ups with practical business networking training. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Business networking is the deliberate development of professional relationships through relevant introductions, value exchange, and appropriate follow-up. For business development professionals, client relationship managers, and team leads, this training offers a structured way to identify priority contacts and plan relationship-building activity. You’ll practise mapping networks and stakeholders, designing referral pathways, and tracking follow-ups and objectives in an Excel relationship plan.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already interact with clients, colleagues, suppliers, or industry contacts and want a more deliberate way to develop and maintain business relationships.
prerequisites: Prior experience in a role involving professional contacts, client relationships, or stakeholder interaction is recommended. Bring a laptop with Excel or an equivalent spreadsheet available; no coding is required. Exercises use a blank workbook and do not require a provided dataset or access to a professional networking account.
